pokemon_scp.name: Magnemite
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0081 is to be contained in an electromagnetic isolation chamber with Faraday shielding. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-0081 to strong magnetic fields.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0081 is a levitating metallic organism composed of magnetized alloys. It generates electromagnetic pulses capable of disrupting electronics within a 10-meter radius.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Neutral but reactive. Moves toward electrical currents and metallic objects.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0081-A: SCP-0081 disabled a monitoring array with a sudden EMP burst.
Addendum 0081-B: Magnetic output increases when SCP-0081 is agitated.

pokemon_scp.name: Magneton
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0082 is to be contained in a reinforced Faraday vault with triple-layer grounding. Personnel must not enter without insulated suits.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0082 consists of three linked SCP-0081 instances that generate amplified electromagnetic fields. Capable of producing EMP bursts strong enough to disable facility-wide systems.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when disturbed. Displays coordinated movement and synchronized pulses.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0082-A: SCP-0082 caused a blackout across two containment wings.
Addendum 0082-B: Magnetic field intensity exceeded safe thresholds during testing.

pokemon_scp.name: Farfetch’d
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0083 is to be contained in an aviary chamber with weapon confiscation protocols. Its leek stalk must be stored separately in a locked case.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0083 is an avian organism that wields a hardened plant stalk as a weapon. The stalk shows anomalous durability and can deflect metal objects.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Proud and territorial. Attempts to retrieve its stalk at every opportunity.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0083-A: SCP-0083 breached containment by using its stalk to pry open a vent.
Addendum 0083-B: Stalk samples show cellulose density far exceeding natural limits.

pokemon_scp.name: Doduo
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0084 is to be contained in a running track enclosure with padded walls. Personnel must avoid standing between SCP-0084’s heads.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0084 is a dual-headed avian organism with shared motor control. Heads communicate via rapid vocalizations and synchronized movement.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Skittish and fast-moving. Displays confusion when heads disagree.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0084-A: SCP-0084 reached speeds exceeding 60 km/h indoors.
Addendum 0084-B: Vocalization patterns show signs of complex communication.

pokemon_scp.name: Dodrio
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0085 is to be contained in a reinforced sprint vault with shock-absorbent barriers. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0085’s charge behavior.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0085 possesses three heads with distinct personalities. Capable of running at extreme speeds and delivering powerful peck attacks.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly aggressive. Heads coordinate attacks with alarming precision.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0085-A: SCP-0085 shattered a reinforced barrier during a charge.
Addendum 0085-B: Behavioral analysis suggests complex tri-lateral decision-making.

pokemon_scp.name: Seel
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0086 is to be contained in a cold-water enclosure with ice platforms. Personnel may interact with SCP-0086 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0086 is an aquatic mammal capable of generating localized cold fronts. Body temperature drops significantly during play behavior.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Friendly and energetic. Shows preference for icy surfaces.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0086-A: SCP-0086 lowered water temperature by 12°C during a play session.
Addendum 0086-B: Fur samples show anomalous insulation properties.

pokemon_scp.name: Dewgong
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0087 is to be contained in a deep cold-water vault with ice regeneration systems. Personnel must avoid exposure to SCP-0087’s freezing breath.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0087 can generate freezing mist capable of immobilizing targets. Body temperature remains near 0°C at all times.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but defensive. Freezing mist output increases when SCP-0087 is startled.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0087-A: SCP-0087 froze a containment drone solid.
Addendum 0087-B: Ice mist shows crystalline patterns resembling fractal snowflakes.

pokemon_scp.name: Grimer
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0088 is to be contained in a toxin-resistant sludge chamber with chemical neutralizers. Personnel must avoid contact with SCP-0088’s body mass.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0088 is a sludge-based organism composed of toxic semi-liquid matter. Capable of dissolving organic material and corroding metal.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Slow-moving but persistent. Attempts to engulf objects.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0088-A: SCP-0088 dissolved a steel pipe in under 20 minutes.
Addendum 0088-B: Chemical analysis shows SCP-0088’s sludge adapts to neutralizing agents.

pokemon_scp.name: Muk
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0089 is to be contained in a hermetically sealed toxin vault with industrial-grade neutralizers. Personnel must not enter without full hazmat gear.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0089 is a highly toxic sludge organism capable of producing airborne fumes that cause respiratory failure. Body mass can expand and contract unpredictably.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and corrosive. Attempts to breach containment through chemical erosion.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0089-A: Airborne fumes incapacitated two guards.
Addendum 0089-B: SCP-0089’s mass expanded by 40% during a rage event.

pokemon_scp.name: Shellder
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0090 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic enclosure with shell integrity monitoring. Personnel may interact with SCP-0090 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0090 is a bivalve organism with a shell capable of withstanding extreme pressure. Tongue appendage shows mild adhesive properties.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful and curious. Frequently attempts to latch onto objects.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0090-A: SCP-0090’s shell resisted a hydraulic press.
Addendum 0090-B: Tongue adhesive strength increases when SCP-0090 is excited.
